core_obligations: Connection change analysis: for another C-infinity connection nibar = nabla + Gamma with Gamma in C-infinity(U, T^*_X tensor Hom(V,V)), one has nibar^2 f = nabla^2 f + Gamma(f)(f') . f' and inductively nibar^s f = nabla^s f + P_s(f ; nabla^1 f, ..., nabla^{s-1} f) where P is a polynomial with C-infinity coefficients in z in U of weighted homogeneous degree s in (xi_1, ..., xi_{s-1}) (lines 885-896).

Consequent isomorphism comparison: the two trivialisations isomorphisms J^k V iso V^{oplus k} correspond through a C*-homogeneous fibre transformation (xi_1, ..., xi_k) -> (xi~_1, ..., xi~_k) with xi~_s = xi_s + P_s(z ; xi_1, ..., xi_{s-1}) (lines 897-905).

Rescaled component expansion: with xi_{s,eps} = eps_s^s xi_s one gets xi~_{s,eps} = xi_{s,eps} + eps_s^s P_s(x ; eps_1^{-1} xi_{1,eps}, ..., eps_{s-1}^{-(s-1)} xi_{s-1,eps}) = xi_{s,eps} + O(eps_s/eps_{s-1})^s O(|xi_{1,eps}| + ... + |xi_{s-1,eps}|^{1/(s-1)})^s using the weighted homogeneity of P_s (align block, lines 906-915).

Error bound via the mean value inequality: | |x|^gamma - |y|^gamma | <= gamma sup_{z in [x,y]} |z|^{gamma-1} |x-y| bounds the error term of |xi~_{s,eps}|^{2b/s} - |xi_{s,eps}|^{2b/s} by (eps_s/eps_{s-1})^s (|xi_{1,eps}| + ... + |xi_{s-1,eps}|^{1/(s-1)} + |xi_{s,eps}|^{1/s})^{2b} (lines 916-922).

Uniform C-infinity convergence and connection independence: when b/s is an integer, analogous bounds hold for every derivative D_{z,xi}^beta (|xi~_{s,eps}|^{2b/s} - |xi_{s,eps}|^{2b/s}), so the rescaled metric converges to (sum_{1<=s<=k} |xi_s|^{2b/s}_h)^{1/b} uniformly on compact subsets of V^{oplus k} setminus {0} in C-infinity topology, independently of the connection (line 923-924 plus the statement's display for the limit).
proof_roadmap: Compare two connections through the polynomial defect terms P_s of weighted homogeneous degree s.
Transport the rescaling through the C*-homogeneous fibre transformation and expand the rescaled components.
Bound the error of the powered norms with the mean value inequality.
Conclude uniform C-infinity convergence on compacts and independence of the connection.
